t: Easyfix galvanised clout nails are robust fasteners designed for secure and long-lasting applications. These corrosion-resistant nails are ideal for roofing, outdoor construction, and other general building projects where durability is crucial. With a 2.65mm diameter and 30mm length, these clout nails provide a strong hold for various materials. Each 1kg pack contains approximately 660 nails, making it a reliable choice for both indoor and outdoor professional use, ensuring consistent performance in demanding environments.
b: Suitable for Both Indoor & Outdoor Use
Approx. 660 Nails Per Pack for Efficiency
